Campaign Performance Recap · Apr 15 — Jun 15, 2026

Q2 2026 Performance Recap

Nine weeks. Four paid platforms. Eight campaigns across seven countries. A look at what worked, what stalled, and where the next dollar should land.

Slide notes

This deck summarizes paid media, CRM, creator, and coupon performance across the 9-week window from April 15 to June 15, 2026. Read alongside the weekly export from the data warehouse. Currency is reported in local markets; aggregates on the deck summarize in USD-equivalent spend and revenue as sourced from the BI feed.

2/12
Headline KPIs

$776.8k in revenue on $412.2k of spend. ROAS held at 1.88x across nine weeks.

Efficiency is improving but uneven: the gain is concentrated in Pinterest and Canada, while the UK is the only market pulling the ratio down.

Total Revenue $776.8k 26,651 purchases · $29.15 AOV Spend scale-up +14% period-over-period
Blended ROAS 1.88x Jun w2 recovered to 2.50x +0.18x vs prior 9-week window
Paid Spend $412.2k $45.8k/wk average 23.9M impressions, 18.2M reach
CPA · AOV $15.47 / $29.15 CTR 3.78% · CPC $0.46 Funnel stayed on plan
Slide notes

Headline KPIs are computed from the daily paid export only. Revenue figures reflect tracked purchase_value in the ad-platform feed, not last-click Shopify orders. AOV here is blended across all paid touchpoints.

Peak week Jun w2 $123.7k revenue · 2.50x ROAS

4/12
Platform Mix

Pinterest carried both the highest ROAS and the most shareable playbook.

Pinterest outearned every paid platform on ROAS while keeping the lowest CPA. Google Ads is the laggard on efficiency at scale.

  • Pinterest: 2.42x ROAS · 8.4k purchases on $106k.
  • TikTok: 1.83x ROAS, but the highest reach at 6.6M views.
  • Meta and Google are balanced on volume; both need creative refresh to lift CPA.

6/12
Country Mix

Canada is the strongest market; the UK is the only one losing efficiency at scale.

Top ROAS lives in Canada and the US, with Germany, Australia, and France clustered near 1.86x. UK dropped to 1.38x despite solid volume.

  • Canada: $190.4k revenue on $77.5k spend · 2.46x.
  • United Kingdom: $71.2k revenue on $51.7k spend · 1.38x.
  • Singapore paid the highest CPA but supported the APAC launch.

7/12
CRM Channels

SMS beats email on click rate by 5 points; CTOR is 21% across the program.

460 sends · 443 delivered · 190 opens · 40 clicks. Unsubscribes held at 0.45%. Post Purchase is the strongest opener; Abandoned Cart needs a creative fix.

Open rate 42.9% 190 of 443 delivered
Click rate 9.0% Deliverable clicks
CTOR 21.1% Clicks ÷ opens

Engagement rate by flow

Open rate and click rate · Source: crm_touchpoint_export

Slide notes

Engagement rate is delivered-opens divided by delivered messages. CTOR (click-to-open) is clicks divided by opens. Post Purchase outperforms on rate but its small send volume caps revenue impact.

Creator Posts

180 creator posts drove 21M views and 207k link clicks — TikTok carried the volume.

Comparison and Unboxing content led on average views. Approvals and right status lag: only 51 of 180 have approved usage rights.

9/12
Coupon Redemptions

260 redemptions added $29.4k in subtotal — discount depth ate $2.58k of margin.

WELCOME10 and FREESHIP convert by volume; Bundle Trial converts by AOV. The percentage code CREATOR20 drove the heaviest absolute discount.

  • WELCOME10: 46 orders · $5,616 subtotal · highest count.
  • CREATOR20: 44 orders · 10% off, smallest average order.
  • Fixed-amount codes (BUNDLE25, BFCM20) account for 38% of redemptions.

Redemption by coupon code

Source: coupon_redemption_export · 6 codes

Slide notes

Discount depth is the leading indicator of margin erosion. CREATOR20 returns the lowest AOV per redemption — pairing with creator content is producing the right intent but smaller baskets.

10/12
Funnel

From reach to purchase, the funnel holds an 11.6% click-through and 2.95% close rate.

Clicks → landing-page-views holds the largest drop at 28.9%; the rest of the funnel is steady. Creative that lands on the LP closer is the lever.

  • Reach → Click: 4.97% of unique reach clicked.
  • LPV → Add to Cart: 10.5% of LP views added a SKU.
  • Add to Cart → Purchase: 39.6% converted to a paid order.

Paid media funnel · stage conversion rate

Vertical bars show volume; line is drop-off vs prior stage

Slide notes

Click → LPV is the weakest transition (71% retention). Optimize click destination and matching landing page copy before spending more on creative alone.

11/12
Takeaways

Three moves shape the next 9-week window.

Evidence

Pinterest and Canada delivered 2.4x+ ROAS on $106k of spend. Creator-led campaigns cleared 2.0x. CRM hit a 43% open and 21% CTOR across 6 flows.

Mechanism

Discovery intent on Pinterest compresses the path from reach to purchase. Creator creative on TikTok tops the funnel but converts further down via a Pinterest follow-up. Welcome and retargeting close at parity.

Implication

Reweight budget toward Pinterest + Canada, restart Bundle Trial only with lighter discount depth, and clear the rights backlog so the top 51 creators can be re-paid for paid amplification.

Slide notes

Three recommendation lines, each paired to the data presented. The implication slot is the action: budget reallocation, margin reset, and rights work.

12/12
Closing

Reweight to Pinterest and Canada. Reset discount depth. Use the rights already earned.
